{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders (they are not revenue)
valid_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99) — though none found
qa_orders = valid_orders[valid_orders['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print("QA orders in completed set:", len(qa_orders))

# Confirm only two channels exist
channels = valid_orders['channel'].unique()
print("Channels in valid orders:", channels)

# Compute total revenue per channel
revenue_by_channel = valid_orders.groupby('channel', observed=True)['revenue'].sum()
revenue_by_channel = revenue_by_channel.sort_values(ascending=False)

# Output results
revenue_by_channel"}
